title: Normalization of the geometric isomorphism cancellation against the derived adjunction unit
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $S$ an arbitrary scheme, $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, and $i:X\xrightarrow{\sim}P$ a specified isomorphism of schemes. In ordinary unbounded small-etale $A$-module derived categories write $F_i=Li^*$, $R_i=Ri_*$. Let $\rho_i:F_i\text{ followed by }R_i\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{Id}_{D(P_{\mathrm{et}},A)}$ be the concrete isomorphism called pushPull in [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]: identify $Ri_*$ with $L(i^{-1})^*$ by the exact/right-derived comparison and the derived image of upperStarInvIsoLowerStarHom, then use the inverse pullback compositor for $i^{-1}$ followed by $i$, the identity pullback comparison and the exact/left-derived comparison. Here upperStarInvIsoLowerStarHom is the unique isomorphism between the two left adjoints of $(i^{-1})_*$, namely $(i^{-1})^*$ and $i_*$, where $i_*\dashv(i^{-1})_*$ comes from the geometric direct-image equivalence. Let $\eta_i:\mathrm{Id}\to R_iF_i$ be the unit of the canonical derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. For every $K\in D(P_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$\eta_i(K);\rho_i(K)=\mathrm{id}_K.$$
Thus $\rho_i(K)$ is precisely the inverse of this unit, rather than an unspecified equivalence cancellation. There is no twist, exponent, trace, splitting, proper morphism $X\to S$, or base-change hypothesis.

proof.text: On sheaves with values in ModuleCat A, write L=i*, R=i_*, V=(i^-1)* and U=(i^-1)_*. The geometric direct-image equivalence e has counit d given by lowerStarComp followed by lowerStarId. The inverse of gamma=upperStarInvIsoLowerStarHom is the left-adjoint uniqueness map from e to the V adjunction. The defining Hom-equivalence equation therefore gives gamma.inv at LM = R(eta_b at LM);d at VLM. This uses Mathlib homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, without changing the specified equivalence.

proof.text: Set c=(upperStarComp for i^-1 followed by i).inv;upperStarId. Naturality of d and of lowerStarComp rewrites eta_a;gamma.inv_L;c as the composite-adjunction unit followed by the direct-image compositor and the image of c. Apply upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app to replace the composite unit and compositor by the identity-map unit and the image of upperStarComp.hom. Cancel upperStarComp.hom with its inverse. Then upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app and lowerStarId.inv_hom_id give eta_a;gamma.inv_L;c=id. All these source lemmas apply directly to ModuleCat-valued sheaves.

proof.text: R is exact because it is naturally isomorphic to the exact functor V. For the exact levelwise derived adjunction, prove unit;D(gamma.inv)_D(L);(D-compositor).inv;D(c);D(identity)=id. Check equality of natural transformations after precomposition with Qh, using Localization.natTrans_ext. The existing source equations mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_unit_app_fac, mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fach, mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fach and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh rewrite the entire composite as Qh of the ordinary homotopy unit, gamma.inv, compositor, c, and identity comparison. Represent a homotopy complex by a cochain complex; the composition and identity comparisons are their canonical identities, and in each degree Step 2 proves that the composite is identity. Functoriality of Qh finishes the calculation.

proof.text: Expand the exact levelwise adjunction as the actual derived adjunction transported along leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Naturality of the right-derived comparison and of D(gamma.inv) puts its unit formula in the same factor order as pushPull. Expand pushPull, leftDerivedUpperStarComp, leftDerivedFunctorNatIso and leftDerivedFunctorCompIso. Adjacent inverse exact/left-derived comparisons cancel. Functoriality of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso splits D(c) into the inverse ordinary compositor and ordinary identity comparison. The remaining equation is precisely Step 3 at K, proving the requested equation for the specified unit and specified pushPull.
